incidents.title: Karmelo Anthony Trial — Closing Arguments (Day 5)
incidents.location: Collin County Courthouse, McKinney TX (~200 mi NE) / Austin monitor
incidents.detail: Closing arguments begin Tuesday in the Karmelo Anthony murder trial — the most emotionally charged day of the proceeding. Prosecution will argue Anthony was the aggressor who had no legal justification to use deadly force: he was in another team's tent, was asked to leave multiple times, had a knife already in hand, and stabbed Metcalf in the chest. Defense will counter that Anthony acted in a split-second fear response to Metcalf's physical contact and had a reasonable belief of serious bodily harm. Anthony did NOT testify in his own defense — defense rested Monday without calling a single witness who substantiated the self-defense claim. Analysts assess prosecution holds strong advantage. Jury deliberations could begin Tuesday afternoon or Wednesday. Verdict window: ~June 10–20. CRITICAL: The moment closing arguments begin and especially if a verdict is announced, Austin protest risk escalates to HIGH. Monitor Capitol/Congress Ave corridor, UT campus, and social media platforms (X, Telegram, Instagram) continuously. No confirmed permitted marches today, but spontaneous gatherings likely if verdict breaks.
incidents.source: Court TV / Fox News / YouTube live coverage

incidents.title: Israel–Iran Mutual Ceasefire Pause — Fragile Truce Resumes
incidents.location: Middle East (national geopolitical awareness; Austin diaspora monitor)
incidents.detail: Israel and Iran traded long-range missile exchanges Sunday–Monday for the first time since an April ceasefire. Iran launched ~30 ballistic missiles at Israeli targets; Israel struck Iranian air defense installations and a petrochemical facility in western Iran. By Monday evening, both sides declared a pause in hostilities. Netanyahu stated the situation is 'contained'; Iran's president confirmed a halt while demanding Lebanon ceasefire conditions. Trump pressured both sides on Truth Social. AUSTIN RELEVANCE: Iranian diaspora community sentiment significantly elevated ahead of FIFA WC (Iran plays June 15 vs. New Zealand in LA). Iranian team is staged in Tijuana — U.S. officials blocked their base camp entry. Protest activity from Iranian diaspora is expected to intensify through WC. Monitor any community gatherings or demonstrations around Iranian match dates. No direct Austin threat but elevated baseline awareness required.

incidents.title: NBA Finals Game 3 — Trump at MSG; Presidential Security Footprint
incidents.location: Madison Square Garden, New York City (national awareness)
incidents.detail: President Trump attended NBA Finals Game 3 (Knicks vs. Spurs) at Madison Square Garden Monday night — the first sitting U.S. president to attend an NBA Finals game. NYPD and Secret Service established a multi-block perimeter, canceled outdoor watch parties, implemented TSA-style screening, and required 2-hour early arrival. Trump was booed during the National Anthem and upon arrival at MSG. NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani also attended. No Austin nexus. Monitoring note: national political temperature remains elevated; any local Knicks/Spurs watch party activity or political demonstrations are low-risk but should be logged if they occur near property.

civil_unrest.title: Karmelo Anthony Trial — Closing Arguments; Austin Protest Risk at PEAK
civil_unrest.location: McKinney TX (trial) / Austin Capitol/Congress Ave/UT Campus (monitor)
civil_unrest.detail: Closing arguments today represent the highest single-day civil unrest risk in this trial cycle. Social media mobilization for Austin demonstrations has been building for 48+ hours. Civil rights groups have publicly called for rally activities tied to any verdict outcome. Both a conviction AND an acquittal carry demonstration risk — particularly on social justice grounds given the all-white jury controversy. Monitor X, Instagram, Telegram for 'Austin' protest coordination keywords. Key watch zones: Texas State Capitol grounds, Congress Ave bridge, UT West Mall, 6th Street. Exterior staff should be briefed to avoid engaging demonstrators and to immediately report any crowd movement toward the property.
